english.note: This is the all-purpose conversational choice for pointing out how two things resemble each other.
Use this for the similar aspects or points of resemblance between different things.

examples.english: I think these two films have a lot of similarity.
examples.traditional: 我覺得呢兩套戲有好多相似嘅地方。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 ni1 loeng5 tou3 hei3 jau5 hou2 do1 soeng1 ci5 ge3 dei6 fong1

examples.english: There are many points of correspondence between these two paintings.
examples.traditional: 呢兩幅畫有好多相似嘅地方。
